upgrade.title: Can I upgrade or downgrade anytime?
upgrade.answer: Yes! You can upgrade to Premium at any time. If you downgrade, you'll keep Premium features until the end of your billing period.

limit.title: Are there annual limits on books?
limit.answer: There are no annual limits — all users can add as many books as they want to their library.

refunds.title: Do you offer refunds?
refunds.answer: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on all Premium plans. If you're not satisfied, contact our support team for a full refund.

payment.title: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through our payment partner, Lemon Squeezy, which acts as the merchant of record and handles VAT and sales tax.
